### A Misunderstood Commandment - Greg Laurie Devotion - May 13, 2022
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-may-13-2022.html
Passage: Exodus 20:7
Points:
- Taking God's name in vain means treating it in a flippant, insincere, or empty manner.
- Using Jesus' name as an exclamation or profanity unintentionally acknowledges that his name has unique power.
- Casual phrases and popular text abbreviations often misuse God's holy name without serious thought.
- Professing Christ while living in deliberate disobedience is the most damaging way to take his name in vain.

### Honor the Parents God Gave You
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/honor-the-parents-god-gave-you
Passage: Exodus 20:12
Points:
- God assigns specific parents to each person to reflect his creative love and sovereign design.
- Learning submission within the home trains the human heart to honor and revere God.
- The household serves as our earliest practice ground for respecting all rightful authorities in society.
- Adult children transition out of childhood obedience, yet the call to honor parents remains a lifelong duty.
- God's promised blessing for keeping this commandment ultimately points believers toward our eternal home.

### The Third Commandment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-third-commandment
Passage: Exodus 20:7
Points:
- In the Bible, God's name embodies his divine character and demands total reverence.
- Contemporary culture treats this commandment lightly by constantly using the Lord's name as an expletive.
- Cursing, gossiping about, or slandering fellow image-bearers is an overlooked way of dishonoring God's name.
- Believers must actively seek the Holy Spirit's help to guard their speech from careless and harmful talk.

### Honor Your Father and Mother (In-Law) - Crosswalk Couples Devotional - November 19
Author: Michelle S. Lazurek
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-couples-devotional/honor-your-father-and-mother-in-law-crosswalk-couples-devotional-november-19.html
Passage: Exodus 20:12
Points:
- Scripture calls children to remember the sacrifices of parents and give them due respect.
- Those who have lost parents can extend this honoring principle to in-laws and parental figures.
- Respect can be expressed practically through intentional phone calls, thoughtful gifts, and dedicated time together.
- Because life on earth is fragile and short, believers should consistently show love to their family elders.
